error[ZC-E0703]: this agent's build cannot serve a job's relay
  cause  the job asks for relay llm; this agent has no relay support
  fix    run the job on a node whose agent supports relays
  more   zcube explain E0703 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0703.html
